description: Container and tag loader requests to googletagmanager.com: gtm.js, gtag/js, and the ns.html noscript iframe.

params.name: id
params.description: Container and tag IDs carry a product prefix: GTM for a container, G for Analytics, AW for Google Ads, DC for Floodlight. The prefix set is observed rather than published, so an unrecognized prefix is only a warning.
params.fix_hint: Use the container or tag ID from the install snippet.

params.name: l
params.description: It names a custom data layer variable and is omitted when the default `dataLayer` is used.
